long_biography.plain_text:
Design Studio grew around graphics that make vehicles and commercial premises visible to customers. Established on Askøy in 1997, the business produces car wraps, signs, window decoration and print, with in-house advice on visual identity. Rune Johnsen has chaired its board for more than two decades and was its sole registered shareholder before a colleague took a minority stake.

The firm also owns a separate investment and property-development company that Johnsen manages at the same Kleppestø address. Børge Nilsen now manages the original branding business day to day, while Johnsen remains its majority shareholder and chairman.
